I answered Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-random: the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is ticket **PD-4821**.

That number comes from a #central-team conversation on Jun 9, 2026, where Hollis said the import was attached to PD-4821. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so they can see it, and a ticket number is an operational fact that's fine to share in the channel. I also passed on the open issue from that conversation: the import file labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs fixing before anyone reimports, or there will be duplicate doors.

There's no Marrow folder in the shared files, so I couldn't check the ticket's current status.
